Samantha — thanks, and appreciate the PDF. Quick notes and next steps from our side: 

1) Owner & timeline
- Redwood will own the offer manifest submission and coordinate with Contoso for identity proofs and SKU descriptions. I'll be the primary contact for submission. Naomi will drive the technical validation checklist.

2) What we need from Contoso this week
- Publisher admin email + Azure AD tenant ID (to validate publisher claim)
- One service principal with Contributor on the offer subscription (or guidance to create one we can use for smoke tests)
- SKU list CSV (see example attached)

3) What Redwood will provide
- Manifest draft (we'll share a first-pass within 48 hours)
- Test harness for entitlement checks and a short runbook to validate token exchange and SKUs

I've attached the SKU template we prefer. Please confirm: do you have a planned co-sell SKU mapping (Microsoft MPN details) or do you want Redwood to propose mapping based on your current pricing?

Attachments:
- sku-identity-matrix.csv (CSV, 6KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodai.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint 0: Azure marketplace onboarding — publisher identity + technical preflight

Hi Samantha / Michael — putting down the technical gating items we typically validate in Sprint 0 so we have a concrete checklist. Please review and flag anything unique to Contoso: 

Technical preflight checklist (Sprint 0)
- Tenant & publisher proofing: verify publisher claim via tenant ID and signed legal entity (received).
- Offer manifest: SKU IDs, plans, meter dimensions, and pricing object.
- Entitlement test harness: ability to exchange an entitlement token for a working API key or trial account.
- Service principal access: SPN with at least Reader + ServiceSpecific role for smoke tests (we prefer minimal rights; Contributor OK for initial run).
- PrivateLink/Networking: confirm if offer requires PrivateLink or a marketplace-managed endpoint. If yes, we need VNet peering details.
- Telemetry & SSO: SSO proof for any SAML claims and telemetry endpoints that will be called during validation.
- Security checklist: basic scanning report (SCA) and pointer to SOC2 report if available — optional but accelerates intake.

If Contoso can provide tenant ID and SPN by EOD Thursday we can complete the manifest validation and schedule a quick smoke test on Friday.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: David Liu <david.liu@contoso.com>

Thanks Naomi — quick clarifications from Contoso engineering: 
- Tenant ID: 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47
- SPN: we'll create an SPN with Reader + Contributor for the testing AD subscription; credentials will be shared securely.
- PrivateLink: not required for our initial offer; we'll use a public endpoint behind IP allowlist.
- SOC2: we have a SOC2 Type II report but it sits behind our portal. We'll share a signed pointer doc next.

Attaching the initial SKU CSV per Michael's template.

— David

Subject: Re: Sprint 0: Azure marketplace onboarding — publisher identity + technical preflight

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. Two operational notes before we run the entitlement smoke tests: 

1) Secure credential handoff
- Please upload SPN credentials to the secure Redwood transfer (we will provide a one-time upload link). Do NOT send creds over email.

2) Token exchange flow we will validate
- We will request a marketplace entitlement token from Azure and do a sample flow to exchange it for a temporary API key. Contoso: ensure the endpoint that validates entitlement tokens accepts a bearer token header and returns 200 on success.

3) Manifest preview & scheduling
- Michael will share the manifest draft by Friday morning. Naomi and I will schedule a 45-minute smoke test window for Friday 11:00 PT (notify if that conflicts).

If all goes well we'll request the marketplace team open the technical gate and move to offer publishing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Cloud Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
